title: R3-2 and R4 districts (flat-roof envelope, ZR 23-422, residences not subject to 23-421) - maximum building height
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the flat-roof envelope HEIGHT constraint for R3-2 and R4 per NYC Zoning Resolution section 23-422 (City of Yes, Last Amended 2024-12-05). Section 23-422 states, for the districts R3-2 and R4, 'for residences not subject to the provisions of Section 23-421, the maximum building height shall be 35 feet.' The source gives these a single maximum building height (35 ft) with NO base-height / setback split - so ONLY max_building_height is emitted; a base height and a setback are NOT invented. R3-2 and R4 ALSO carry a pitched-roof envelope under 23-421 (25 ft perimeter / 35 ft ridge); the section is selected by BUILDING TYPE. This flat rule applies to the non-pitched forms ('residences not subject to Section 23-421'); the pitched forms are handled by the SEPARATE rule r3-r4-pitched-height, so the two envelopes never conflate (cross-section isolation). FAIL-CLOSED INPUT: building_type has no canonical property_profile field, so it is unavailable in practice and the evaluation returns professional_review_required with no value; a supplied pitched building type yields a visible not_applicable here (the pitched rule governs). The 35 ft flat cap is a DIFFERENT construct from R4B's 25 ft flat cap (r4b-height) and from the 23-421 pitched 25/35 ft caps - never inherited. NOT a Verified determination.

citations.quote: R3-2 R4 In the districts indicated, for residences not subject to the provisions of Section 23-421, the maximum building height shall be 35 feet.

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations of a building or other structure shall be as set forth in Section 23-421 (Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts) and 23-422 (Basic flat-roof envelopes for certain districts). ... The height of all buildings or other structures shall be measured from the base plane.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Applicability is in_set R3-2/R4; every other district (including R4B, R3A, R3X, R3-1, R4-1, R4A, and the R5 family) is NOT matched (visible not_applicable). District SCOPE is enforced by applicability, not an input-domain enum.

inputs.name: building_type
inputs.description: Building type. REQUIRED and FAIL-CLOSED: no canonical property_profile field exposes building type, so in practice this is unavailable and the evaluation returns professional_review_required with no value. This flat rule applies to 'residences not subject to the provisions of Section 23-421' - represented by the engine values 'attached'/'other' (section 23-422's own negative definition; NOT source-named building types). The source-named pitched forms detached/semi_detached/zero_lot_line yield a visible not_applicable here (the pitched rule r3-r4-pitched-height governs), so the pitched-vs-flat selection is explicit and never guessed.

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.commercial_overlays[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.special_districts[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: historic_district
inputs.description: True iff the lot is in a designated Historic District (section 23-426); when a caller supplies true -> professional_review_required.

outputs.name: max_building_height
outputs.description: Maximum building height (ft) for R3-2/R4 under the 23-422 flat-roof envelope. Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result. No base-height/setback split exists for R3-2/R4 in this section.

parameters.name: building_height_ft
parameters.note: R3-2/R4 maximum building height 35 ft (section 23-422, residences not subject to 23-421). Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

steps.note: Maximum building height for R3-2/R4 under the 23-422 flat-roof envelope.

exceptions.description: A commercial overlay may modify residence-district height (section 23-44); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
A mapped special district may modify height (section 23-44); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
In a designated Historic District the height may be constrained (section 23-426); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict).

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.
The source gives R3-2/R4 (flat) only a maximum building height (35 ft) with no base-height/setback split; a base height and a setback are not invented.
Building height is measured ABOVE THE BASE PLANE (section 23-42); the base-plane determination is a separate professional input.

R3-2 and R4 also carry a PITCHED-roof envelope (section 23-421, 25 ft perimeter / 35 ft ridge) selected by building type; that is a SEPARATE rule (r3-r4-pitched-height). The engine building_type values 'attached'/'other' represent 'residences not subject to Section 23-421' and are NOT source-named building types; building_type has no canonical source, so this rule fails closed to professional_review_required in practice.

The section 23-424 qualifying-residential-site / qualifying-senior-housing increase and the section 23-425 large-site modification are conditional alternatives not modeled here (A2 gaps, geography/eligibility dependent).
